# Coverage progress

**Generated by `scripts/progress.py`. Do not hand-edit** — a coverage table
maintained by hand drifts from the measurements, and a stale number here is
worse than none.

## 533/1101 flawed functions found (48.4%)

- **446/1101 (40.5%) surfaced** — high and medium confidence, what the
  report shows without `--all`. This is the number a user actually sees.
- **138/3294 (4.2%) correct functions flagged.**
- Static layer, default flags. `--ikos` and `--ctu` add more; the dynamic
  column is a separate run and **must not be added to the static one**.

### What 'total' means here

The denominator is the **40-file sample per CWE**, not the whole suite —
Juliet has 101,231 files and CWE-121 alone has 7,889. Raising `--limit`
changes both numbers, so only compare runs at the same limit. 100% of the
sample is not 100% of Juliet, and neither is the goal on its own: the
suite is synthetic, and `docs/juliet-inventory.md` says why its scores do
not transfer to real code.

**B** a default checker does it, **C** a shape rule Kordon writes, **D** needs
a value bound, **E** cross-TU or ownership, **F** defined behaviour that no
tool can decide, **G** needs semantics no analyzer has.
